comments.text: There’s probably no reason to comment on a 2 year review, but I’ve owned a pair of BOSE QC 35 II headphones since early 2019 and recently bought these air pod maxes. It’s ridiculous how much more comfortable the Boses are. Yes, I know that it’s in their name QC, but still. After taking off the Maxes, the QC feels like a pillow, both in its weight and it’s cushioning. It’s like bicep curling 30 pounds and then switching to 15. The Sound bleed is also absolutely atrocious. At roughly the same volume at 75% in a silent room, the vocals, drums and melodies of songs are clearly distinguishable while, honest to God, I didn’t hear a single noise from the QCs on somebody else’s head. I own a ton of apple products, including 2 Macs at my business’s office, an Apple Watch, a personal MacBook, and only a history of IPhones, and my Apple Bias still couldn’t win. The only thing I’d give the Maxes is that the sound was slightly better, but the Boses have been beaten up for 5 years with the cushions being replaced only once. My key takeaways from the maxes is how heavy they are, how uncomfortable the cushioning is, and how easy it is to connect to my Apple products.
